title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
summary: Listen Labs abandoned a Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures to pursue acquisition talks with Salesforce. This strategic pivot marks a significant shift from independent fundraising to potential acquisition.
content: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.

zh.title: AI研究初创公司Listen Labs为了Salesforce收购谈判放弃15亿美元融资轮
zh.summary: Listen Labs放弃了来自Menlo Ventures的C轮融资条款，以追求与Salesforce的收购谈判。这一战略转变标志着从独立融资到潜在收购的重大转变。
